<p>I appreciate the phone calls, notes, flowers, condolences, etc. about my unsuccessful bid (again) for Homecoming Queen…(heavy sigh) Please do not blame yourselves - it’s really all on me - I started my campaign way too late to win this year, but I did score a pretty paper ticket so progress is being made!<strong>&nbsp;</strong></p><p><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," height="320" width="240"></p><p>And most importantly, my paper ticket admitted me into a Crimson Tide shutout performance no less! Woohoo! Good guys win again!&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;The cutest score of the day had to be the uninvited guest in oxford who is just lucky Juice Kiffin (lane kiffin’s dog who is not only a good boy but also a great <em>follow </em>on X) did not get a hold of him.&nbsp;</p><p><a href="https://www.facebook.com/share/r/j3CezzzHZWcY22U2/?mibextid=UalRPS" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank" style="color: blue;">https://www.facebook.com/share/r/j3CezzzHZWcY22U2/?mibextid=UalRPS</a></p><p>So, now Tide fans can enjoy a stress-free bye weekend before they travel to baton rouge to play the tigers who also have a bye this weekend…in our night game (eek) in death valley.&nbsp;</p><p>One team with a stressful weekend just days away would be the gators playing the fighting kirbys in the world’s largest outdoor cocktail party. Considering how georgia is playing, florida will likely savor less toasting and more drowning their sorrows, and this game kickstarts florida’s hellacious stretch of play continuing next with tx, lsu and ole miss in the weeks to come. Yikes.&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;Probably the biggest pressure bowl of this upcoming weekend will be vandy on the road in boogville. If the commodores’ quarterback can work his magic they will be bowl eligible. Now, you may recall back in the day, when the aubs sold their soul to the devil to secure home field victories…no matter what their score deficit was, some insanity would ensue to secure their win?! Well, that contract has apparently been rescinded in the past few years. Is it possible the devil thought hugh freeze’s soul was too sleezy for even him?! I have no evidence of this, but I have seen their play at home and there’s really no other explanation. Bottom line, the aubs have to win this game against vandy and at least two more of their following three games to be bowl eligible. (See Alabama fans…we are counting wins/loses to be eligible for the College Football Playoff…perspective.)</p><p>Don’t forget to fall back this Sunday and enjoy Week 10 even though our beloved Tide is not playing!
